idea-plugin.name: quick-coding
idea-plugin.description:
quick-coding — Generate MyBatis Code from Database Tables

Right-click one or more database tables in the Database tool window to quickly generate a complete set of MyBatis code:

  • Entity class (Lombok-annotated)
  • Mapper interface with MyBatis annotations
  • Mapper XML mapping file (resultMap + CRUD)
    • MySQL: ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    • PostgreSQL: ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE SET
  • Service interface and ServiceImpl
  • Controller (REST, optional Swagger annotations)

Feature highlights

  • Method-level navigation between Java Mapper methods and their XML statements
  • Multi-module aware: pick the target module, source/resource paths follow automatically
  • Customizable templates (FreeMarker): edit or create your own template groups in Settings
  • Batch insert / insert-or-update statements included
  • Optional SQL schema prefix and Swagger annotations
  • Option to add generated files to version control automatically

How to use

  1. Connect a data source in the Database tool window (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB ...)
  2. Right-click a table (or multi-select several tables)
  3. Choose Generate Code
  4. Configure the options and click OK

Requires Ultimate Edition (Database tools plugin).
